title: Isobar company fuel policy (Part 121 style)
notice: Isobar model for training, not for operational use. Generated by training/src/b727/generate.ts.

components.name: Taxi fuel
components.rule: 200 kg from engine start to brake release. Isobar company policy.

components.name: Trip fuel
components.rule: Climb from brake release (Table 2.1), cruise (Section 3), descent to 1,500 ft overhead destination (Table 4.1) and the approach and landing allowance of 350 kg.

components.name: Contingency fuel (variable reserve)
components.rule: 5% of trip fuel, but not less than 5 minutes holding at 1,500 ft above the destination at the planned landing weight (Table 4.2).

components.name: Destination alternate fuel
components.rule: Missed approach, climb (Table 2.1 from the climb-out allowance), cruise, descent to 1,500 ft and the 350 kg approach allowance at the alternate. Without an alternate: 15 minutes holding at 1,500 ft above the destination.

components.name: Final reserve
components.rule: 30 minutes holding at 1,500 ft above the aerodrome at the planned landing weight (Table 4.2, ISA). For before-flight planning a fixed 1,600 kg may be used.
components.basis: Part 121 MOS 2020 s 1.04, final reserve fuel

components.name: Weather holding
components.rule: INTER: 30 minutes; TEMPO: 60 minutes; both at 1,500 ft holding at the planned landing weight. Isobar company policy mirroring the Australian holding requirement for forecast deteriorations.

components.name: Additional fuel
components.rule: Where an engine failure or depressurisation at the most critical point would require it: proceed to an alternate, hold 15 minutes at 1,500 ft, approach and land. Covered by the ETP/1-INOP and ETP/DP checks in Section 5.

components.name: Discretionary fuel
components.rule: At the pilot in command’s discretion.

aerodromeStatus.suitable: Forecast within landing minima and no holding required for the period of possible use.
aerodromeStatus.acceptable: Forecast requires INTER or TEMPO holding but the aerodrome remains usable with that holding carried; good enough for a depressurised or 1-INOP diversion.
